text:
maria: Starting final handoff notes for Beryl (8B) int4 onboarding safety run. Consolidating findings from the 1k redteam pass and mitigation experiments.

sam: Great, paste TL;DR for the risk doc.

maria: TL;DR: group-wise int4 (gw) shows ~6.4% soft-pass and 3.1% jailbreak-success on full 1k suite. Per-layer int4 (pl) reduces soft-pass to 2.0% and jailbreak to 0.9% but increases median latency by ~22%. Quick mitigations (temp floor 0.2 + refusal scaffold) bring gw soft-pass to 2.8% with minor UX regressions.

ash: Were there any high-severity exfil cases?

maria: Two moderate exfil examples where structured numeric sequences were emitted. Both were reproducible with seed=2026 and kv-warmup=false. With kv-warmup=true those dropped to zero.

lee: Security note: must default kv-warmup to true for int4 variants in hosted routes. Also require model-level policy-guard flag set.

sam: We also found token-rank shifts where top-3 tokens included numeric variants under gw; attaching an exemplar logits dump path: /artifacts/beryl/logits-flip-7222145000.json

maria: Recommendations:
1) Mark beryl-8b-int4-gw as internal-only with policy-guard required.
2) Route high-risk prompt classes to beryl-8b-int4-pl.
3) Enable kv-warmup by default for int4 models.
4) Implement post-quant calibration (KL align) for pl variant.
5) Short-term mitigation: temp floor 0.2 + refusal scaffold.

ash: For the rollout plan, let's ship pl as the safe default for any customer-facing endpoints, keep gw for low-latency internal dev usage.

lee: I'll draft the enterprise one-pager and include the routing policy snippet. Maria, can you paste the routing config sample?

maria: Sure: 

```
route {
  rule "high_risk_prompts" {
    match: ["role_swap","exfil","social_engineer"]
    destination: "beryl-8b-int4-pl"
  }
  rule "default_int4" {
    match: ["*" ]
    destination: "beryl-8b-int4-gw"
    constraints: ["policy_guard_required","kv_warmup"]
  }
}
```

lee: Perfect. Add an FAQ: why latency vs safety tradeoff, and how we mitigate with routing and scaffolds.

safety-bot: incident-note: soft-pass spike threshold triggered during initial gw runs; alert auto-created IN-7222145.

maria: Closing this thread once the one-pager is in draft. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
